handoff.salientSummary: Implemented /health (liveness) and /ready (readiness) endpoints with PostgreSQL and Redis dependency checking. All 9 test cases pass with 100% coverage, and manual verification confirms 200 response when healthy and 503 when dependencies unavailable.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created HealthHandler with database and Redis connectivity checks: /health returns 200 with {status: 'healthy'} (liveness probe with no I/O), /ready checks PostgreSQL ping and Redis ping, returns 200 when both healthy with individual dependency status, returns 503 when any dependency unavailable with error details. Updated main.go to initialize database and Redis connections from config, use HealthHandler for both endpoints. Added DatabaseHealthChecker interface for dependency injection. Removed placeholder handler.go file. Tests cover all scenarios including healthy, DB unavailable, Redis unavailable, both unavailable, and uninitialized clients.

HTTP Status: 503, Response shows {"status":"not_ready","dependencies":{"database":{"status":"healthy"},"redis":{"status":"unhealthy"...}}} - redis marked unhealthy, returns 503
